subject: Maintainer appreciation pack & credits request for DataPulse autumn sprint
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@datapulse.dev>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: maintainer appreciation pack for our Autumn Community Sprint

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well — long-time admirer of Redwood’s tooling. I co-organize the DataPulse Community Sprint (Oct 23-25), and we run a small cohort for open-source maintainers from underrepresented regions. We’d love Redwood’s support in two parts: 1) a promo/credits pack we can offer maintainers to accelerate evaluation, and 2) a small event stipend for travel reimbursements/honoraria.

Quick details:
- Expected maintainers: ~25 (mostly hobbyist maintainers)
- Use cases: onboarding, small-scale model evals, embeddings for search demos
- Asks: $3k in platform credits (usable in 6 months) + $1k honorarium (one-time)

Attached is our one-page sprint proposal and a sponsorship form. Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Community Lead, DataPulse
attachments: datapulse_sprint_proposal.pdf
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@datapulse.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: maintainer appreciation pack for our Autumn Community Sprint

Hi Samira — welcome, and exciting event!

A few quick clarifying questions so I can route internally:
- Are the credits scoped to a specific team or account per maintainer, or should we provision a pooled credit bundle that you distribute?
- The $1k honorarium: is that one lump sum to the org to disburse, or individual stipends?
- Do you have required logo/boilerplate for Redwood we need for approvals (legal/marketing)?

I’m looping in Marissa on community partnerships for program details. I’ll also route to Aditya in sales for the credits approval. If you can confirm the distribution model and any deadlines for approval by EOD Tue (10/6) that would be helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Program Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@datapulse.dev>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: DataPulse Community Team <community@datapulse.dev>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: maintainer appreciation pack for our Autumn Community Sprint

Thanks, Tessa — answers below and I attached a filled sponsorship form.

- Credits distribution: Pooled credit bundle that DataPulse will allocate as needed (maintainers will register and we’ll issue codes). We can also accept a per-email allotment if that’s simpler for Redwood.
- $1k honorarium: one lump sum to DataPulse (we handle disbursement to maintainers), invoice info included in the sponsorship form.
- Logo/boilerplate: yes — we need Redwood logo for the event website and a short sponsor blurb. I attached the sponsorship_form_filled.pdf.

Deadline: Ideally we'd like confirmation for credits by Oct 12 to finalize registrants.

Appreciate it — Samira
attachments: sponsorship_form_filled.pdf

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: maintainer appreciation pack for our Autumn Community Sprint

Aditya — forwarding a quick community sponsorship ask from DataPulse. Proposal asks: $3k credits (6-month redemption window) + $1k honorarium to be paid to DataPulse. Event is Oct 23-25; they’d like confirmation by Oct 12.

Rationale: high density of early-stage maintainers who could become long-term users; good PR with a lightweight logo + demo slot. Typical community partner ask but the honorarium is a cash disbursement (finance needs to approve).

Can we approve $3k credits under the community credit program and route $1k to finance for a one-off sponsorship? If you need more detail I can set up a 15-min sync.

Thanks for the context — happy to approve.

Decision:
- Approve $3,000 in platform credits, valid for 6 months from issuance.
- Approve $1,000 one-time honorarium to DataPulse; Marissa, please coordinate with Finance (create supplier onboarding if needed).

Conditions:
- Include Redwood logo and sponsor blurb (Marketing to sign off via Marissa).
- We’ll issue credits as a pooled promo code (Billing: create promo DP-AUTUMN-26).
- No additional contractual obligations — standard community sponsorship terms only.

Marissa — can you handle Marketing/Finance coordination and confirm issuance timeline by Oct 9 so we can meet DataPulse’s Oct 12 ask?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Growth — Redwood Inference
